feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 September 2026 8:27am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 02 September 2026 at 8:25am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later tonight.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of the British Isles, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea at times over the next few days.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 4 or 5, veering South or Southwest this afternoon or evening, then veering West or Southwest tonight and increasing 5 occasionally 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle, risk of mist patches for a time, then becoming fair later today.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain and drizzle, poor in any mist patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 occasionally 6, decreasing 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, then increasing 5 or 6 later tomorrow or overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
